verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a hosted SaaS code-review service, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers PR triggers, effort levels, rules and git-host integrations, but never mentions a versioned API, API versioning scheme, or deprecation policy. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show documentation accessibility, not API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
